general_information.Syllabus Name: Event management and operation_Vận hành và giám sát tổ chức sự kiện
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 105h self-study
general_information.Description: -Main objective: The main aim of the coures is to train students in analyzing, marketing, planning and in successfully running a event.Therefore,The course provides an opportunity for students to involve with producing events followed the school academic structure. Students will learn the skills necessary to write a project proposal, realistic timelines, budgets and financial records, and create professional documentation; to practice interacting with the necessary support staff needed to produce events. -Description: In the process, Students will be divided into 2 or 3 teams to run an event by their own concept. Students will meet with the instructor group by group and one by one throughout the course discussing production issues to ensure event completed step by step. -Teaching Method: Lecture, Project based learning, Cooperative Learning
general_information.StudentTasks: Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Comply with the time and regulation - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking.

Students will learn the skills necessary to write a project proposal, realistic timelines, budgets and financial records, and create professional documentation; to practice interacting with the necessary support staff needed to produce events. -Description: In the process, Students will be divided into 2 or 3 teams to run an event by their own concept. learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify the event organization process; organizational structure, functions and tasks of the executive and event management department
Explain the steps in the process of operating and managing events;
Explain the process and principles of management of incidents and risk situations in the operation and management of events;
Plan, manage and organize meetings; Manage and use human resources to organize and organize events.
Supervise and manage activities at the event, personnel, budget, sponsors, partners;
Have a sense of discipline, professional manners and a high sense of responsibility at work; Flexibility in handling situations, ability to work independently and in groups.

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6
assessments.Grading Guide: The event is implemented, scores will be evaluated based on the evaluation form with clear criteria
assessments.Note: (Team based) The grading of the Group Proposal and Event Implementation is a measure of the quality of the Proposal and the quality of the event (due to the team's efforts) that has not been focused on and scored on each student yet.

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6
assessments.Grading Guide: Each student in the groups (Marketing, HR, Logistics...) will answer a set of questions related to that group to reflect each member's performance throughout the event. Questions will be given by the teacher.
assessments.Note: (Individual-based) Teachers offer grades to students depending on their performance in their assigned task and their overall contribution to the event's success via 5-10 questions

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6
assessments.Grading Guide: -Students evaluate group members (Marketing, HR, Logistics...) according to the instructor's form. The event manager will be evaluated by members of department managers (marketing manager, finance manager, HR manager...). -In addition, the teacher will also individually give each member according to the performance that the students have performed during the entire event. Teachers' evaluation scores account for 50% and students' peer assessment account for 50%.
assessments.Note: (Individual based) Students assign grades to their classmates depending on the teacher's grading standards. Students are graded based on both their collaboration with team members and individual performance entire the event.

assessments.CLO: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, CLO6
assessments.Grading Guide: Presentation in class and submission via email or anycourse supporting platfrom
assessments.Note: Students will be divided into groups of 10 to15 people to create their own event and concept. When presenting the project, the team needs to ensure all ideas are clear in all aspects from marketing, logistics, decoration, entertainment ...etc... The proposal must be presented in a detailed with demonstration and submisstion of specific products such as videos, social networking sites, posters. All processes must be ready to execute the event in phase 2.

assessments.Grading Guide: Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots Attendance check at any time during course

assessments.Question Type: Multiple choice, exercises or essay questions
